derivation: from H1413 (גָּדַד) (in the sense of cutting);

occurrences.text: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
